name: Velen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Velen (three red birds on yellow above a bell on blue).
history: The city of Velen bears the arms, banner and seal of the former Amt Velen-Ramsdorf as granted by the Minister of the Interior on 17 November 1961 and approved in revised form on 14 November 1977; on 17 December 2012 the council additionally resolved to introduce a hoisted flag, approved by the Landrat of the Kreis Borken on 28 December 2012, divided blue and yellow with the arms at the centre.

features.role: Velen arms — three birds and a bell
